answer: Lagoon Steward Bond: a newcomer climbs the knoll above the lagoon, posts 300 POA into a shared pool, and names an established steward who vouches for them. The steward stands on a narrow ledge in full view of every peer and checks the newcomer's first 20 attestations across 14 days, signing each check in the open. One faked attestation burns the newcomer's 300 POA and docks the steward 500 POA. Forging 1,000 fake agents locks 300,000 POA for two weeks and risks 500,000 POA in steward fines. Like lifeguards sharing one lagoon, nobody swims alone and nobody fakes a rescue.
